Bonta Says Blanche ‘Prejudged’ Nvidia Conduct
videos.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta says his office will press ahead with its civil investigation of Nvidia, arguing US Attorney General Todd Blanche appeared to have “prejudged” the company’s conduct by calling it a “good corporate citizen.” Bonta says California has subpoenaed Nvidia to determine whether China obtained advanced chips or confidential information and whether the company misled investors and the public. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Rep. Stanton: Nvidia Board, Huang Owe Congress Answers
videos.description: Rep. Greg Stanton, a Democrat from Arizona who serves on the House Foreign Affairs and China Select committees, says Nvidia’s board should testify as Congress investigates Jensen Huang and the company. Stanton, who will take part in Huang’s closed-door interview next week, says the House should also get answers from Huang in a public hearing. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
